14. Separation of concerns

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Separation of concerns isolates distinct responsibilities so that a change in one area need
not unnecessarily change others.
සිංහJලෙන් UI, authentication, business logic සහ database queries එකම function එකක දාන්න එපා. ඒවා
A pharmacy changes its UI without changing stock validation rules.
UI Display · Auth Access · Domain Stock rule · Data Storage · Read the diagram: Each card represents a separate design idea. · එක් card එකක් එක් අදහසක් Jපන්වනවා.

Q: What is the benefit?
A: Focused modules are easier to change, test and understand, with less unintended impact.
